finding.headline: "No Village"
finding.problem: "In Lagos my mum would be here massaging me and taking the baby. Here it's just me and the ceiling at 4am. I feel abandoned by my own culture."
finding.person: UK/US-based African mum whose omugwo helper left after 2 weeks (or never came); partner works, she's alone overnight.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Angle / Bundle component (diaspora edition of B1).". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
